attrs.description: The connection between a force and the acceleration it causes on a body. The proportionality constant m is the inertial mass, which is found to me the same as the gravitational mass.
attrs.plain: The stronger a force exerted on an object, the larger its acceleration. The bigger an objects mass the smaller the acceleration for the same force (hence it acts "inertially")

variables.meaning: The sum of Forces on an object
